Package aor.proj3t.service.interfaces

Interface ExportService

All Known Implementing Classes:
ExportServiceImpl
public interface ExportService
Service interface for data export operations. This interface defines the contract for comprehensive data export functionality supporting multiple formats (CSV, PDF) and various data types including users, evaluations, and trainings.

Key export services include:

  • User Data Export: Comprehensive user information export with filtering capabilities
  • Evaluation Export: Detailed evaluation data export with performance metrics
  • Training Export: Training program and participation data export
  • Multiple Formats: Support for CSV and PDF export formats
  • Advanced Filtering: Customizable data selection and filtering options
  • Professional Formatting: Well-structured documents with proper styling

This service provides essential reporting and data analysis capabilities for administrators and managers, enabling data extraction for further processing, archival, or compliance purposes.

    • exportEvaluationToPDF

      byte[] exportEvaluationToPDF(Long requesterId, Long evaluationId)
      Exports a single evaluation to a PDF format file.

      This method exports a specific evaluation with its detailed information to PDF. It includes all relevant data about the evaluation, evaluator, and evaluatee.

      Parameters:
      requesterId - the ID of the user requesting the export.
      evaluationId - the ID of the evaluation to export.
      Returns:
      a byte array containing the PDF data.
